lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters organized in approximately nine vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The columns exhibit a semi-regular grid spacing along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular blobs to form a distinct matrix. These intersections act as primary anchor nodes for the grid-like patterning.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear ridges are visible. The primary mid-lateral ridge shows a sharp luminance transition with a light upper edge and a shadowed lower edge, running from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct piscine silhouettes (remoras) are visible in the ventral-midline water column, characterized by high-contrast white lateral stripes.
